title: Doctorado en Probabilidad y Estadística
about: CIMAT's Doctorado en Probabilidad y Estadística lists tentative admission dates for a January 2027 start: online applications 15 October-24 November 2026, interviews and exams by 5 December, classes from 19 January 2027. An August 2027 intake follows.
requirements: January 2027 start: online applications 15 October - 24 November 2026; interviews and entrance exams by 5 December 2026

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: "Probability and statistics" (field) and skill "Statistics" -> "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples."
Skill "Probability" -> "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
